thread:
maria: Deploybot flagged a surge in errors for semantic-search-v1 on runtime 3.15 in us-central. Warmup failures + degraded cosine similarity outputs. Proposing we soft-unpin 3.15 for that model group during the 01:00 UTC change window to route traffic back to 3.14. Thoughts?

sam: can you paste the alert + example failing outputs?

maria: alert: https://telemetry.internal/alerts/17666 - error rate ~4.2% over 15m, p99 gen latency 3.1s, a few customers reported degraded similarity scores in SRE slack. Example: embeddings returned different norms vs baseline.

deploybot: automated: anomaly detected runtime=3.15 model_group=semantic-search-v1. Created quarantine ticket Q-5020.

ops: do we know if this is kernel-level or model artifact? last night's model refresh touched quant tables for this family

maria: triage: reproduced locally with model artifact pinned to previous commit and runtime 3.15 -> still fails. Switching runtime to 3.14 locally fixes the issue. Stack traces point to quant decode path in runtime.

lucy: any impact to dedicated fleets or private deploys? we need to know for customer comms

maria: dedicated fleets pinned to runtime 3.15 will remain as-is. This action is a soft-unpin at routing layer only for hosted eu-central and us-central model cohorts (semantic-search-v1). Customers routed to pinned fleets won't be forced to change.

sam: please add the deploybot CLI lines for runbook so night team can execute quickly

maria: runbook snippet:
```
# quarantine semantic-search-v1 and route back to runtime 3.14 in us-central
deploybot quarantine --model-group semantic-search-v1 --reason "quant-decode-regression-3.15"
deploybot set-routing --model-group semantic-search-v1 --target-runtime 3.14 --region us-central --mode soft --canary 0.1
```

ops: propose ramping plan: 10% for 10m, 40% for next 10m, then full if metrics normal. Also add automated rollback triggers.

maria: agreed. suggested rollback triggers: sustained failed_ops >=2.5% for 5m OR p99 > 2.5s for 10m -> auto rollback and page oncall. Escalate to runtime leads if error rate >6% or customer SLA exceptions noted.

oncall: I'll stand up the incident channel at 00:45 UTC and watch through the window. Add me to watchers.

lucy: draft customer-facing blurb for status page / support triage: short + technical optional paragraph

maria: draft: "We detected an operational regression affecting some quantized embedding outputs for semantic-search-v1 in us-central. We have temporarily routed affected traffic to the prior runtime to preserve accuracy while engineers investigate. No action is required on your side; we will provide updates on the status page."

sam: minor tweak: call out affected region and model family explicitly in the public blurb.

maria: updated blurb added to Q-5020. Also attached failing backtrace and embedding checksum diffs: https://gist.internal/qa/semsearch-5020-diff.txt
deploybot: scheduled-action: soft-unpin will run at 1766678400 (2026-03-25T01:00:00Z) unless cancelled. Ticket Q-5020 updated with runbook and watchers.

ops: QA checklist for night: 1) run 5 short queries and 5 long queries, compare cosine similarity to baseline; 2) verify KV cache warmups hit >90% for short prompt; 3) confirm embedding checksum parity for a sample of 10 queries between 3.14 and 3.15 after routing change.

maria: adding the QA checklist to the ticket now. plan: execute soft-unpin, watch 30m for regressions following ramp. If problems persist, escalate to immediate rollback of the routing change and open an incident review.

oncall: when the action kicks off I'll create #inc-q-5020 and add watchers [maria, sam, oncall, ops]. Please ping me 10m before scheduled action.

maria: thanks everyone. tagging @deploybot for confirmation and lock-in of schedule. :white_check_mark:

deploybot: confirmed: schedule locked, runbook attached, watchers set [maria, sam, oncall, ops].
